summary: Plan v54 BLOCKED: Modified Lindenbaum seed approach is mathematically impossible. Under irreflexive semantics, G(neg(F(phi))) can coexist with F(phi) in an MCS, making g_content(M) ∪ {F(phi)} inconsistent. This kills ALL seed-based F-preservation approaches (v53 and v54). The gap_contradicts_prior tool also fails in the constant-MCS case. The correct resolution path is proving chronicle_gap_contradiction via the FROZEN GUARD construction argument: when U(T,bot) at point a is processed, bot is placed in the guard, preventing interstitial domain points. This makes succ(a) = next construction point, and a well-founded argument shows succ_cofinal.

blockers.description: Plan v54 seed approach impossible: g_content(M) ∪ {F(phi)} can be inconsistent when F(phi) ∈ M. Under irreflexive semantics, G(neg(F(phi))) ∈ M puts neg(F(phi)) in g_content(M). Also: multi-witness seed {phi_1,...,phi_m} is inconsistent (phi_1=p, phi_2=neg(p)). Also: gap_contradicts_prior fails in constant-MCS case (Z+Z counterexample: all points contemp_equiv, class = entire domain, unbounded).
